column1: # CVE-2026-17084 — CPython stringprep B.3 outputs that differ across the fix.
# Generated once from Lib/stringprep.py at 7e109d0 and its parent, then frozen: the
# test is tier 1 and must not reach the network.
# The pre-fix `map_table_b3` falls through to `str.lower()`, so the SET DEPENDS ON THE
# INTERPRETER that generated it. Measured on CPython 3.13.9, UCD 15.1.0:
# 711 code points. Issue #713 reports 684 from a host with a different UCD; the
# block distribution is identical and the difference is entirely in the Latin and
# Cyrillic counts, which is what a newer `str.lower()` moves.
